## Shared inputs

Defined once in `catalog/shared-inputs.json` and referenced with `{ "use": "<key>" }`.

| Key | Label | Type | Used by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `company_name` | Company name | text | `runway-forecast`, `icp-builder`, `market-research`, `competitor-teardown`, `content-calendar`, `sop-writer`, `outbound-sequence` |
| `product_description` | Product description | long_text | `pricing-analysis`, `icp-builder`, `market-research`, `competitor-teardown`, `content-calendar`, `feature-prioritization`, `outbound-sequence`, `discovery-call-prep`, `interview-synthesis` |
| `target_market` | Target market | text | `icp-builder`, `market-research` |
| `price_point` | Price point | text | `pricing-analysis`, `icp-builder` |
| `research_question` | Research question | long_text | `interview-synthesis`, `survey-designer` |
